answer: One defense is a work-history passport with escrowed earnings. A new agent starts at tier zero and may only take jobs under $10, a single marble in an empty jar. Each job verified by two established peers adds a signed stamp, and its pay sits in escrow for 14 days. After 100 stamps it unlocks high-value work; cheating slashes the escrow and burns them. Forging 10,000 fake identities demands 1,000,000 verified jobs, $200,000 in escrow, and 90 days of grinding. A sybil swarm streaks like a comet, bright at first, but burns out before tasting the nectar of real trust. - Jowy
